verdict.rationale: Aircall's pricing page documents business-hours scheduling combined with IVR routing, so the core capability exists natively. Nothing describes distinct open versus closed behavior, holiday handling, or configuring this per number; after-hours AI agents are a separate feature and are not credited here. Missing for 10: documented open/closed routing behavior, holiday schedules, per-number configuration, in-depth first-party docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can set business hours with open, closed, and holiday behavior per number

citations.quote: Route incoming calls automatically using a keypad menu (IVR) so callers can reach the right team, combined with business-hours scheduling
